# Father Figure Nutrition — Full Reference

> Veteran-owned supplement brand built for hardworking men. 80% organic. Zero fillers. Made in USA.

## Brand Overview

Father Figure Nutrition is a veteran-owned men's supplement brand founded to help hardworking men — dads, professionals, and active lifestyles — rebuild strength, energy, and consistency through simple, effective daily nutrition. Every product is formulated with 80% organic ingredients, manufactured in GMP-certified facilities, third-party tested, and backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee.

- **Founded by:** U.S. Military Veteran
- **Mission:** From "dad bod" to discipline — performance supplements for men who lead
- **Manufacturing:** USA, GMP Certified, Third-Party Tested
- **Guarantee:** 60-Day Money Back
- **Site Designer:** [Majestik Magik](https://majestikmagik.dev)

## Technical Features

### 3D Interactive Product Viewer
- CSS-based 3D cylinder renderer (no WebGL dependency)
- 32-segment polygon mesh for smooth curvature
- Drag-to-spin: mouse and touch support
- Pinch-to-zoom on mobile
- +/- zoom buttons
- Auto-spin at 30fps (throttled for CPU efficiency)
- Starts from back of bottle, holds 1.2s, then spins to front
- Lazy-loaded .webp label textures
- Built with React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS

### Tech Stack
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Vite (build tool)
- Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- Zustand (cart state)
- Shopify Storefront API (cart & checkout)
- Supabase (backend / edge functions)
- TanStack Query (data fetching)
